summary: SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT_v1 draft artifacts pass all critical doctrine checks. First exterior spec — validates the exterior domain dispatch pipeline. 31 tasks thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json (originally 30, split TSK_SDNG_EQUIPMENT_SETUP into SPRAY/BRUSH variants per QA-001). All PaintScope keys use PS_EXT_* namespace. All substrate states use SS_EXT_* prefix. All protection zones use ext_* prefix. No interior keys, states, or zones present. Environmental conditions correctly excluded from estimation per RC-003. Window/door protection correctly excluded per RC-001. 5 research corrections applied. 3 QA issues resolved/acknowledged.

issues.description: TSK_SDNG_EQUIPMENT_SETUP used per-method fixed_time_minutes object instead of a single value.
issues.resolution: Split into TSK_SDNG_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_SPRAY (45 min, spray/spray_backroll) and TSK_SDNG_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_BRUSH (20 min, brush_roll). Task count now 31 (was 30).

issues.description: TSK_SDNG_END_SEAL and TSK_SDNG_KNOT_PRIME use EA unit but lacked PaintScope keys.
issues.resolution: Added manual_capture_required: true with manual_capture_item, manual_capture_uom, and manual_capture_notes to both tasks. These are estimator-entered counts not sourced from PaintScope.

issues.description: COV_SDNG_PRIMER uses coverage_by_state (per substrate) and COV_SDNG_FINISH uses coverage_by_profile (per siding type). These are new coverage model patterns not used in interior specs.
issues.resolution: Patterns documented. Coverage models: (1) per_substrate_state — coverage varies by SS_EXT_* input state, (2) per_siding_profile — coverage varies by siding_profile config dimension. Engine support deferred to engine implementation phase.

doctrine_checks.details: All paintscope_key references use PS_EXT_* namespace. No interior keys found.
All substrate states use SS_EXT_* prefix. 9 states declared. No SS_INT_* or bare SS_ IDs.
All protection zones use ext_* prefix. No interior zone IDs (floor_perimeter, wall_adjacent, fixture_covers). Window/door zones correctly excluded per RC-001.

Environmental conditions (wind, dew point, sun, surface temp) intentionally excluded from estimation per RC-003. These are process/scheduling concerns, not estimatable modifiers. Access type treated as height modifier (RC-004).
FAC_EXT_ACCESS declared. FAC_EXT_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION declared. FAC_SIDING_PROFILE declared. Environmental FAC_EXT_WIND/SUN/TEMP correctly excluded per RC-003.
All modifiers use division formula: effective_rate = base_rate ÷ modifier. Stacking cap 4.0× declared.

Each primer system declares substrate_states compatibility. Tannin primer for bare cedar/redwood. Bonding primer for chalking/stain. Factory prime requires field prime (SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC covers SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY).
No geometry computation. All geometry from PaintScope inputs.
All required inputs declared with paintscope_key mappings.
All 30 tasks have unit_of_measure declared (SF, EA, LF, FIXED).
All production rates match task UOM.
Backroll rates equal spray rates (200 SF/hr prime, 225 SF/hr finish). Coupling rule satisfied.
All inputs flow PaintScope → spec → tasks → rates.
Window/door protection correctly excluded from siding spec per RC-001. No ext_glass_window or ext_glass_door zones.

exterior_validation_summary.interior_contamination: none — no interior keys, states, or zones found
key_architectural_decisions: RC-001: Window/door protection belongs in window/door specs, not siding
RC-002: Fascia is part of soffit system; frieze board is correct lower adjacency
RC-003: Environmental conditions excluded from estimation — not predictable
RC-004: Access type is a height modifier, not a site condition
RC-005: All exterior wood substrate states included (not just NC bare wood)
